Never repeat the hook question in line 2. Shagun's 'Shagun pe kaun sa tax?' did this: it fell from 85 to 48 between the 10% and 25% marks and ended at 4, the worst finish of any Short.

End Shorts on the answer and stop, with no recap or sign-off. Shagun (19→4) and UPI (41→12) lost most of their remaining viewers in the last quarter, while Sensex barely lost any (55→52). We cannot see the closing lines, so check what comes after the payoff.

Long videos: cut the warm-up line ('Chaliye, shuru se dekhte hain', 'Aaiye, sach jaante hain') and the 'kahani suniye / naam maan lijiye' backstory from the first 30 seconds. Both long videos lost more than half their viewers by the 5% mark (about 33 s): 97→45

Long videos: open on one money contradiction, not a question or a survey figure, and say it only once. The '50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill' opening kept 45 at 5% and 7 at the end, against 36 and 3 for the job-loss video. It also said its hook twice. This is
sglearning.thumbnail_look: Make one clear face or object fill a third to half of the frame, set against a strong, saturated background (deep red, gold, electric blue or bright pink, often on dark), with nothing else competing for attention. Add at most two to five words in huge bold letters (white, yellow or red, with a dark outline or bar) taking about a quarter of the frame, big enough to read on a phone.
